say:2:1012121001:1.text: The herbs are normal too, just bitter.
say:2:1012121001:1.source_cn: 药草也很正常，就是苦了点。

say:3:1012121002:0.text: You're not a child, Lorsan. Stop putting everything in your mouth. That herb is a laxative.
say:3:1012121002:0.source_cn: 洛桑……不要什么东西都往嘴里塞。那一株是滋润肠胃的草药。

say:4:1012121003:0.text: Why didn't you say so earlier?!

say:7:1012121004:0.text: No need to worry. He has consumed stranger fare.
say:7:1012121004:0.source_cn: 不必担心，他吃过比这更古怪的东西。

say:8:1012121005:1.text: Curses... I'll let this go this time because of what's happening. But next time, I'm going to give you a talking-to.
say:8:1012121005:1.source_cn: 可恶……今天情况紧急，下次再和你算账！

say:9:1012121006:1.text: All I want to know right now is what's causing all of this since the food and herbs are normal.
say:9:1012121006:1.source_cn: 我现在只想知道，既然食物和药草都很正常，问题究竟出在哪里？

say:10:1012121007:1.text: Let's see what everyone else has to say. Eironn, why do you keep looking west?
say:10:1012121007:1.source_cn: 听听大家的意见吧。不过……埃隆，你为什么一直往西边看？

say:13:1012121008:0.source_cn: 那个方向，是塔兰河的上游。我听村民们说，在塔兰河的尽头...

say:14:1012121009:0.text: Eironn... We don't have time to go gallivanting off to see some beautiful spring right now.
say:14:1012121009:0.source_cn: 埃隆……这都什么时候了？我们哪有心思看风景？

say:15:1012121010:0.text: Upstream of the Taran River... Don't all residents around here use the river water to make <style="highlight">herbal remedies</style>?

say:17:1012121012:1.text: Yes, I see what Eironn is thinking.
say:17:1012121012:1.source_cn: 原来如此，我明白埃隆的想法了。
